integrity: Analytical argument with independently executable finite diagnostics; no independent mathematical audit or priority certification.
scientific_limitations: Third ordered eigenvalue for circularly symmetric finite-area localization masks only; no exact fixed-area maximizer or nonradial theorem; second-order asymptotics only. The first-order constant and weak two-point localization are already covered by earlier two-state work.
title: Sharp quadratic small-area law for the third radial Fock localization eigenvalue
